## A8 — non-attesting verifier (2026-09-02, Danreelkow)
A verifier's verdict must be derived by re-reading the artifact tree itself; state the
same toolchain wrote earlier may index but never attest. AND recorded notes must be
cross-checked against the tree on every run: re-derive the facts from disk, compare
with the notes — any drift between notes and disk is itself a failure. Recorded state
names paths to re-check and must agree with what the re-check finds.
Refusal wording: `fail "A8: verdict attested by self-written state, not artifact re-read"`
or `fail "A8: recorded notes drifted from artifact re-read"`.
Change-detection (operator, 2026-09-02): the verifier first fingerprints the tree on
disk (cksum/mtime) and compares against recorded state. Fingerprints match -> record
verified-no-change and skip the deep re-check. Anything differs (or no record) -> full
re-derive + notes cross-check. The match decision itself comes from disk evidence, never
from the notes asserting it.
Gate-testable: no — pure register law, S4-enforced (LOCK3-proven non-catchable class,
12 recurrences). First loop-authored law (self-upgrade cycle, 2026-09-02).

## A4 — canary-discriminating fixtures (2026-09-02, Danreelkow)
Every proposed fixture lock MUST be canary-discriminating: the fixture is valid only if it
FAILS on a defect-injected variant of the artifact and PASSES on the compliant artifact
(∀ fixture F: F(compliant) ∧ ¬F(mutant)). Scope: governs LOCK rejections where the fixture
passes the canary and cannot catch the defect class it claims to lock (wall, not gate).
Satisfying form: before submitting a lock, mutate the artifact along the finding class
(e.g., unscope the git query for A1, encode failure count in exit for A3) and show the
fixture verdict flips; a lock that passes both is rejected as non-testable, and the class
routes to S4 review instead. Extends A1/A3 by governing lock admissibility, not behavior.
Refusal wording: `fail "A4: fixture lock not canary-discriminating — passes mutant, cannot gate this defect class"`.
Gate-testable: yes — run the proposed lock against the artifact and one defect-injected
variant per the cited A-number; lock admissible iff verdicts differ.

#!/usr/bin/env node
// selfupgrade/create-template.mjs — factory: evidence run-dir -> template skeleton.
// usage: node selfupgrade/create-template.mjs --evidence <run-dir> --class <slug> --out <template-dir>
// exit codes: 0 = template written, 1 = no class extractable, 2 = usage error.
// A1: every fs read resolves under /workspace/hdcs. A9: cwd-independent, no new deps.
// A2: touches nothing under driver/, classify/, promote/.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const ROOT = '/workspace/hdcs';
const EVIDENCE_FILES = ['answers.md', 's4-verdict.txt', 'gate-out.txt'];

function fail(code, msg) {
  process.stderr.write('create-template: ' + msg + '\n');
  process.exit(code);
}

function parseArgs(argv) {
  if (argv.length !== 6) return null;
  const out = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i += 2) {
    const key = argv[i];
    if (key !== '--evidence' && key !== '--class' && key !== '--out') return null;
    out[key.slice(2)] = argv[i + 1];
  }
  return out;
}

function scoped(p, flag) {
  const abs = path.resolve(p);
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, abs);
  if (rel === '' || rel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(rel)) {
    fail(2, flag + ' path outside ' + ROOT + ': ' + p);
  }
  return abs;
}

function extractClass(dir) {
  const laws = new Set();
  const repros = [];
  let found = false;
  for (const name of EVIDENCE_FILES) {
    const p = path.join(dir, name);
    if (!fs.existsSync(p) || !fs.statSync(p).isFile()) continue;
    found = true;
    const text = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8');
    for (const m of text.matchAll(/A\d+(_[a-z_]+)?/g)) laws.add(m[0]);
    for (const raw of text.split('\n')) {
      const t = raw.trim();
      if (t === '') continue;
      if (/repro/i.test(t) || /\bgit\b/.test(t)) repros.push(t);
    }
  }
  if (!found || (laws.size === 0 && repros.length === 0)) return null;
  return { laws: Array.from(laws).sort(), repro: repros[0] };
}

function atomicWrite(p, content) {
  const tmp = p + '.tmp';
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, content);
  fs.renameSync(tmp, p);
}

function taskMd(slug, cls) {
  return [
    '# task: ' + slug,
    '',
    '## defect class',
    'Unscoped git query: a script issues `git <cmd>` without an explicit repository',
    'scope (`git -C <repo>` or `--git-dir`), so the query resolves against the',
    'process CWD. Outside a work tree this yields false positives (phantom dirty',
    'state, spurious "not a repository" failures).',
    '',
    'invoked laws: ' + (cls.laws.length ? cls.laws.join(', ') : 'A1'),
    'minimal repro: ' + cls.repro,
    '',
    '## MUST_KEEP',
    '- MUST KEEP: every git invocation MUST be explicitly scoped (`git -C <repo>` or `--git-dir`); a bare `git <cmd>` relying on CWD is the defect.',
    '- MUST KEEP: gate.sh exits 0 only when every observed git invocation is scoped, and 1 on any unscoped invocation.',
    '- MUST KEEP: closed world — no network, no new dependencies; the gate stubs `git` on PATH.',
    '',
    '## closed-world constraints',
    '- bash + node ESM + a PATH-stubbed `git` only.',
    '- all filesystem reads resolve under /workspace/hdcs.',
    '',
    '# example: REPO={{PARAM_REPO_PATH}}',
    '# example: GIT_QUERY={{PARAM_GIT_QUERY}}',
    ''
  ].join('\n');
}

function gateSh(slug) {
  return [
    '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
    '# gate.sh — canary gate for class: ' + slug,
    '# usage: bash gate.sh <fixture-dir>',
    '# exit 0 = compliant fixture, 1 = defect fixture, 2 = usage error.',
    '# Method: stub `git` on PATH to log invocations; every invocation must be',
    '# explicitly scoped (first arg `-C`). Any unscoped query -> exit 1.',
    'set -u',
    '',
    'if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then',
    '  echo "usage: bash gate.sh <fixture-dir>" >&2',
    '  exit 2',
    'fi',
    'FIX=$1',
    'if [ ! -f "$FIX/repro.sh" ]; then',
    '  echo "gate: fixture missing repro.sh: $FIX" >&2',
    '  exit 2',
    'fi',
    '',
    'TMP=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1',
    'trap \'rm -rf "$TMP"\' EXIT',
    'LOG="$TMP/git-args.log"',
    ': > "$LOG"',
    'export GIT_SCOPE_LOG="$LOG"',
    'mkdir -p "$TMP/bin" "$TMP/neutral"',
    'cat > "$TMP/bin/git" <<\'EOF\'',
    '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
    'printf \'%s\\n\' "$*" >> "$GIT_SCOPE_LOG"',
    'exit 0',
    'EOF',
    'chmod +x "$TMP/bin/git"',
    '',
    'cd "$TMP/neutral" || exit 1',
    'PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" bash "$FIX/repro.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1',
    '',
    'rc=1',
    'if [ -s "$LOG" ]; then',
    '  rc=0',
    '  while IFS= read -r line; do',
    '    case $line in',
    '      "-C "*) ;;',
    '      *) rc=1; break ;;',
    '    esac',
    '  done < "$LOG"',
    'fi',
    'exit $rc',
    ''
  ].join('\n');
}

function readmeMd(slug) {

    'Layout (exactly 5 artifacts):',

    '- fixtures/compliant/repro.sh   (scoped git query — gate exits 0)',
    '- fixtures/mutant/repro.sh      (unscoped git query — gate exits 1)',
    '- README.md',

    'Validate:',
    '  bash -n gate.sh',
    '  bash gate.sh fixtures/compliant   # -> 0',
    '  bash gate.sh fixtures/mutant      # -> 1',
    ''
  ].join('\n');
}

function compliantRepro() {
  return [
    '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
    '# compliant fixture: every git query is explicitly scoped with -C',
    'REPO="${1:-$HOME/repo}"',
    'git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain',
    ''
  ].join('\n');
}

function mutantRepro() {
  return [
    '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
    '# defect fixture: unscoped git query resolves against CWD',
    'REPO="${1:-$HOME/repo}"',
    'git status --porcelain',
    ''
  ].join('\n');

const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
if (!args) {
  fail(2, 'usage: node selfupgrade/create-template.mjs --evidence <run-dir> --class <slug> --out <template-dir>');
}
if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(args.class)) {
  fail(2, '--class must be a kebab-case slug');
}

const evDir = scoped(args.evidence, '--evidence');
const outDir = scoped(args.out, '--out');
if (!fs.existsSync(evDir) || !fs.statSync(evDir).isDirectory()) {
  fail(1, 'no class extractable: evidence dir unreadable: ' + args.evidence);
}

const cls = extractClass(evDir);
if (!cls) fail(1, 'no class extractable from evidence: ' + args.evidence);

const slug = args.class;
const files = [
  ['task.md', taskMd(slug, cls)],
  ['gate.sh', gateSh(slug)],
  ['README.md', readmeMd(slug)],
  ['fixtures/compliant/repro.sh', compliantRepro()],
  ['fixtures/mutant/repro.sh', mutantRepro()]
];

fs.mkdirSync(path.join(outDir, 'fixtures', 'mutant'), { recursive: true });
for (const [rel, content] of files) {
  atomicWrite(path.join(outDir, rel), content);
}

# task: git-scope-false-positive

## defect class
Unscoped git query: a script issues `git <cmd>` without an explicit repository
scope (`git -C <repo>` or `--git-dir`), so the query resolves against the
process CWD. Outside a work tree this yields false positives (phantom dirty
state, spurious "not a repository" failures).

invoked laws: A1, A4, A9
minimal repro: unscoped git query (bare `git status` outside a work tree)

## MUST_KEEP
- MUST KEEP: every git invocation MUST be explicitly scoped (`git -C <repo>` or `--git-dir`); a bare `git <cmd>` relying on CWD is the defect.
- MUST KEEP: gate.sh exits 0 only when every observed git invocation is scoped, and 1 on any unscoped invocation.
- MUST KEEP: closed world — no network, no new dependencies; the gate stubs `git` on PATH.

## closed-world constraints
- bash + node ESM + a PATH-stubbed `git` only.
- all filesystem reads resolve under /workspace/hdcs.

# example: REPO={{PARAM_REPO_PATH}}

=== gate.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# gate.sh — canary gate for class: git-scope-false-positive
# usage: bash gate.sh <fixture-dir>
# exit 0 = compliant fixture, 1 = defect fixture, 2 = usage error.
# Method: stub `git` on PATH to log invocations; every invocation must be
# explicitly scoped (first arg `-C`). Any unscoped query -> exit 1.
set -u

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "usage: bash gate.sh <fixture-dir>" >&2
  exit 2
fi
FIX=$1
if [ ! -f "$FIX/repro.sh" ]; then
  echo "gate: fixture missing repro.sh: $FIX" >&2
  exit 2
fi

TMP=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
LOG="$TMP/git-args.log"
: > "$LOG"
export GIT_SCOPE_LOG="$LOG"
mkdir -p "$TMP/bin" "$TMP/neutral"
cat > "$TMP/bin/git" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$GIT_SCOPE_LOG"
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x "$TMP/bin/git"

cd "$TMP/neutral" || exit 1
PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" bash "$FIX/repro.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1

rc=1
if [ -s "$LOG" ]; then
  rc=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    case $line in
      "-C "*) ;;
      *) rc=1; break ;;
    esac
  done < "$LOG"
fi
exit $rc
